# Convert264

> Convert264 is a free video converter for Android. No ads, no account, no watermark — your videos never leave your phone.

## What it does

Convert any video on your Android phone: pick a video or share one to the app, choose the container (MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM), video codec (H.264, H.265, VP9, MPEG-4, Copy), audio codec (AAC, MP3, Opus, Vorbis, FLAC, Copy, None), quality and encoder preset, trim start and end with a real preview — and convert a whole queue in one go.

- Privacy policy: https://github.com/dzianisv/h264-converter/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

## Privacy

Convert264 collects nothing. Conversion runs entirely on your device; the app has no internet permission, so your videos cannot leave your phone.
